title: Expenses
description: Follow an expense all the way, from receipt to bookkeeping.
emptyDescription: Create your first expense by uploading a receipt.

submitBlocker.match: Match it against a bank transaction before you can submit.
submitBlocker.payout: Add your clearing and account number under My profile before you can submit.
submitBlocker.receipt: Upload the receipt before you can submit.
submitBlocker.mileage: Enter the odometer before and after the journey before you can send it.
submitBlocker.incomplete: Fill in the description, date, amount and cost distribution before you can submit.
submitBlocker.futureDate: The purchase date is in the future. Correct it to the day of the purchase before you can submit.
submitBlocker.tooLate: An expense out of your own pocket must be filed within {days} days of the purchase, and this receipt is older than that. The expense stays a draft. To apply for a waiver, get in touch with the skattmästare, who decides whether it is accepted anyway. If the date is wrong, you can correct it.
submitBlocker.tooLateMileage: A mileage claim must be filed within {days} days of the journey, and this journey is older than that. The journey stays a draft. To apply for a waiver, get in touch with the skattmästare, who decides whether it is accepted anyway. If the date is wrong, you can correct it.

event.EXPORT_RELEASED: Released the export lock after checking Fortnox
event.DEADLINE_WAIVED: Granted a waiver from the deadline

detail.missingDescription: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
detail.fortnoxNotConnected: Fortnox is not connected. Connect it under Bookkeeping first.
detail.fortnoxNotSignedIn: You are not signed in to Fortnox. Sign in from your profile and you can export.
detail.unexportWarning: The voucher is still in Fortnox. Delete or void it there, or the next export will create a duplicate.

request_changes.label: What needs to change?
request_changes.placeholder: Write a comment to whoever filed the expense…

return_approved.label: Why is the expense being reopened?
return_approved.placeholder: Write a comment to whoever filed the expense…

unexport.label: Why is the expense no longer exported?
unexport.placeholder: E.g. the voucher was voided in Fortnox…

waive_deadline.label: Why is the waiver granted?
waive_deadline.placeholder: E.g. the receipt went missing and has been looked for since the summer…

detail.revokeWaiverConfirm: The expense is past the deadline and cannot be submitted again without a new waiver.
detail.deadlineWaiverPending: The expense is past the filing deadline. Grant a waiver if it is to be accepted anyway, otherwise it cannot be submitted.

transition.request_changes: Sent back with a request for changes.
transition.return_approved: The expense was reopened for changes.
transition.unexport: The expense is marked as not exported.
transition.recall: The expense is back as a draft
transition.waive_deadline: Waiver granted. The expense can be submitted.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your approval?
withdraw.message: The cost centers you approved become unapproved again and the expense goes back to awaiting approval.

export.attachWarning: The receipt was uploaded but could not be attached to the voucher: {detail}

delete.title: Delete the expense?
delete.message: The expense and its receipt are permanently deleted.

recall.title: Withdraw the expense?
recall.message: It goes back to a draft and leaves the attest queue. You can then change it (from an out-of-pocket purchase to the section card, say) and send it in again. It keeps its reference number.
recall.messageAttested: It goes back to a draft and leaves the attest queue. {count, plural, =1 {One approval is} other {# approvals are}} removed, because they were given for the expense as it stood. You can then change it and send it in again; it keeps its reference number.

wizard.submitFailed: Saved, but could not be submitted
wizard.submitted: The expense was submitted for approval.
wizard.dateFuture: The date is in the future. A purchase cannot have been made later than today
wizard.dateTooLate: Older than {days} days. An out-of-pocket claim has to be filed within {days} days of the purchase.
wizard.dateTooLateCard: Was it the section card you used? Change the payment type at the top and no deadline applies.
wizard.dateTooLateWaiver: You can apply for a waiver: finish the expense, save it as a draft and get in touch with the skattmästare, who decides whether it is accepted anyway.
wizard.paymentTypeFixed: This expense accounts for this bank transaction, so the payment type is fixed. To claim your own money back instead, start a new expense without picking the transaction.
wizard.payoutMissing: Add an account under My profile

claimHint.card: A purchase made with the section's card.
claimHint.cardReturn: Money back to the card, a refund for instance.
claimHint.own: You paid yourself and get the money back.

wizard.reorderFailed: Could not save the order of the documents
wizard.duplicateLead: {count, plural, one {You already have an expense with the same amount and nearly the same date:} other {You already have expenses with the same amount and nearly the same date:}}
wizard.duplicateHint: If it is the same purchase there is no need to hand it in again. If it is a different one, carry on as usual.

newMenu.label: New expense
newMenu.ordinaryHint: You have a receipt: card or your own
newMenu.mileageHint: You drove your own car on the section's errand

match.noneAtAll: There are no transactions on your section card yet.
match.help1: Pick the purchase on your section card. Only purchases of exactly the expense's amount can be picked.
match.help2: A purchase already accounted for on another expense cannot be picked again. Contact whoever has it, or the treasurer.
match.help3: If the purchase shows a different amount, the amount was probably mistyped. Use the button on the row to take the bank's amount.
match.help4: Purchases appear once the treasury has imported the bank statement. If yours is not there yet, save as a draft and come back.

skipped.notRemindable: it is not waiting on anyone
